None has appeared for the applicants.
Even on the preceding date, none had appeared for the applicants.
It appears that applicants are not interested in prosecuting this revision.

2. On a perusal of the petition, it reveals that this revision petition has been filed against the order dated 26.9.2016 whereby charges were framed against the applicants for commission of offence under Sections 498A, 294, 506/34 of IPC.
From the perusal of record it reveals that prima facie sufficient material is available against the applicants for framing of charge.
Hence, it cannot be said that charges have been made framed without any material on record.

sentences.text: 3. Therefore, having taken into consideration, the material available on record, I am of the view that charges have been rightly framed against the applicants.
Hence, there are no grounds to interfere in the impugned order of framing charge.
4. Consequently, this revision petition being devoid of merits, is dismissed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Tara Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170582195/
